title: Global financial crisis
summary: A US housing and credit collapse became a global banking crisis. Indian equities fell by more than half within a year and then rebounded sharply in 2009.

events.text: Global sell-off; Indian markets hit their lower circuit the next morning
Indian equities' worst single day of the crisis
Election result: markets hit the upper circuit

notes: Real prices, replayed day by day through the same brain the live agent uses.
The agent starts a year earlier, so it arrives with positions and learned trust.
The news advisor is silent: no scored headlines exist for these years.
It trades rupee amounts here; the live ₹10,000 book trades whole shares.

At its most invested the replay held 109% of the book in stocks: the replay engine lets cash dip below zero when holdings have outgrown their slots. The live paper book cannot do this, so the replay is slightly more aggressive than live.
